mainEntity.name: How do I calculate time between two times?

acceptedAnswer.text: Convert each to minutes since midnight and subtract. If the end is earlier than the start the span crosses midnight, so add 24 hours to the end.

mainEntity.name: How do I convert minutes to decimal hours?

acceptedAnswer.text: Divide the minutes by 60. 45 minutes is 0.75 hours, and 7 hours 45 minutes is 7.75 hours.
A payroll method that rounds working time to the nearest quarter hour. Up to 7 minutes rounds down, 8 minutes or more rounds up.
